hypothesis.statement: On a real WBDS gait knee angular-speed cycle, the shipped PhysioMoCap sparc and ldlj reproduce an independent Python reimplementation of the Balasubramanian et al. (2015) reference algorithm BIT-FOR-BIT; and SPARC becomes more negative (less smooth) when the movement is corrupted with noise.

analysis_plan.dataset: WBDS (Fukuchi et al. 2018, figshare) gait knee angular-speed cycle, subject 01, time-normalized to 101 points; treated as a movement speed profile at a nominal 100 Hz

decision.threshold: descriptive: sparc and ldlj each equal the Balasubramanian reference to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9)
